codex.title: Codex
dialogue.opening.king.1: Twardowski. The Mirror is broken. Seven shards scatter the realm, seven lieutenants of Hell hold them. Ride your rooster. Bring them back before the Devil claims his bond.
dialogue.opening.twardowski.1: One condition, Majesty. Rome does not touch me.
dialogue.opening.king.2: Then fly. The Moon will not wait.
dialogue.zone4.boruta.1: Four shards, alchemist. Four to go. The Inn waits.
dialogue.zone7.innkeeper.1: A drink, Master? The house pours for travelers weary of the road.
dialogue.zone8.lucyper.1: You sang a hymn once, Twardowski. Sing it again. I will wait.
dialogue.victory.twardowski.1: Seven shards. The Mirror whole. And the Devil? On the Moon where he belongs.

codex.skrzat.lore: Hearth-imp turned saboteur — flings itself at any rooster fool enough to fly over Wawel.
codex.latawiec.lore: A devil-kite bound to a stillborn's soul, riding storm winds with a forked tail.
codex.latawiec.stats: HP 2 · straight dive · single aimed shot
codex.czart.lore: Lesser Mazovian devil that haunts pine groves; horns first, questions never.
codex.bies.lore: Older, meaner kin of the czart — strafes the treeline and barks fire in threes.
codex.licho.lore: Misfortune given shape; only one-eyed, only ever bad news, blinking between heartbeats.
codex.licho.stats: HP 4 · teleport blink · heavy single shot
codex.strzyga.lore: Twice-souled night-flier risen from a buried corpse; swoops on thin rotated wings.
codex.topielec.lore: Drowned man kept by the river — surges up from the Vistula trailing weed and brackish hate.
codex.topielec.stats: HP 4 · emerges from below · upward burst
codex.mamuna.lore: Bog-mother who steals babies and lays mines of egg-shaped curses across the marsh.
codex.nocnica.lore: Night-terror that rides the chest of sleepers; here it streaks across the sabbath sky.
codex.poludnica.lore: Noon-wraith of the harvest — a slim white figure dragging a long, slow scythe.
codex.poludnica.stats: HP 5 · cross-screen rush · wide scythe sweep
codex.wapierz.lore: Catacomb upyr, thick-skinned and patient; spits a five-way cross of cold blood.
codex.dziwozona.lore: Wild-woman of the deep wood — won't fight you herself, but every death births two skrzats.
codex.dziwozona.stats: HP 4 · slow hover · summons 2 Skrzats on death
codex.rokita.lore: Lesser devil of Łysa Góra in his apprentice years — grows brambles to fence the sky.
codex.rokita.stats: HP 150 · roots narrow corridor · seed-shots along roots
codex.leszy.lore: Forest-lord who wears whichever hide he pleases: stag for the chase, bear for the bruise, owl for the kill.
codex.nocny-lowca.lore: The Wild Hunt's outrider, mounted on a spectral horse, his hounds always one breath behind.
codex.madej.lore: Brigand damned to a bed of nails for a hundred unconfessed murders — fights from within it.
codex.madej.stats: HP 300 · 3-lane spike drops · aimed heavy fire
codex.smok-krzemionkowski.lore: The dragon under Wawel's hill, woken by the rift; cone-fire first, then dives in radial six.
codex.smok-krzemionkowski.stats: HP 400/400 · fire cone, then dives + radial 6-way
codex.borowy-krol.lore: Crowned king of the pine forest, rolling boulders down the storm-lit slopes.
codex.borowy-krol.stats: HP 500/500 · boulders, then root walls + seed-shots
codex.wodnik-wislanny.lore: Lord of the Vistula in a bubble-shield of drowned men; you cannot hurt him through them.
codex.wodnik-wislanny.stats: HP 600/600 · water spouts, then bubble shield with 4 Topielec
codex.boruta.lore: Devil-lord of Łęczyca who shattered the Mirror — whip-chains in phase one, mud and Bies in two.
codex.boruta.stats: HP 700/700 · whip-chains, then mud geysers + 3 Bies
codex.baba-jaga.lore: The hut walks on a chicken's leg; she fights from the cauldron, then the mortar, then a broom of light.
codex.baba-jaga.stats: HP 500/500/500 · cauldron bombs · mortar rush · broom-laser sweep
codex.bazyliszek-warszawski.lore: Stone-gaze serpent of the Warsaw catacombs; do not look directly into the cone of light.
codex.bazyliszek-warszawski.stats: HP 600/600/600 · stone-gaze · venom puddles · gaze-beam + teleport
codex.mefistofeles.lore: Hell's notary at the inn called Rzym — shoots the contract back at you, then mirrors the ship that signed it.
codex.mefistofeles.stats: HP 700/700/700 · contract scrolls · fire pits + horns · mirror-twin
codex.lucyper-ksiezycowy.lore: The Devil himself, leaning on the Moon — cosmic rain, then eclipse, then every prior boss at once.
codex.lucyper-ksiezycowy.stats: HP 800/800/800 · cosmic rain · eclipse spotlight · shattered-mirror cycle
